claim1_orthographic_partition.why_untestable: N = 7 total. A 3/4 split of 7 items cannot be statistically distinguished from any other narrative partition of 7 items. This is a statement about sample size, not about whether the claim is true.
claim1_orthographic_partition.not_a_finding_note: This is DESCRIPTIVE. The counts were taken before PREREG.md was written and carry no confirmatory weight.

claim2_directed_transmission.gate: SUPPORTED if diff >= 0.15 and p < 0.01; FALSIFIED if diff <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE

claim2_robustness_post_hoc.reading: The DIRECTION is robust: family A leads in all 10 variants, every p <= 0.0012. The VERDICT is fragile: removing any one of 5 of 10 payload terms drops the effect size below the pre-registered 0.15 gate. Honest summary: direction robust, magnitude marginal.

claim3_adversarial_vocabulary.why: the word lists that would define 'toxic' are the claim itself; choosing them chooses the answer

boundaries: No measurement of a network licenses a claim about a text. Datasets 2-4 of the proposed design measure networks.
Even a fully positive result here would show lexical structure, not purpose. Structure is evidence about a text; purpose is a claim about an author.
Surface-form matching over un-lemmatised text misses forms and admits false positives. This limits precision and is not claimed away.
layer: Layer-1 measurement only; no interpretation is asserted
